Always on (automated): +1 to Reflex and Athlete checks.

Free Action (once per scene): make your next Reflex and Athlete check with advantage.

Conditioning (automated): +5 ft Speed while you own this skill.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
